comment: Every entry in `vitest.config.ts`'s coverage `exclude`, with the reason it exists.
This register is what makes the exclusion set reviewable. `scripts/coverage-exclusions-gate.js` fails when
a config entry has no record here, or when a record has no entry. Without it the exclude list grows by
accretion and the threshold it guards stops meaning anything.
A record is not permission to exclude more: it is a statement that someone looked, and a reason that stays
in the diff where the next reader sees it.
`scripts/baseline-anchors-gate.js` checks the half this register could not: that every recorded path is a path
the repository has. Until iteration 95 this file spent 26 words on
`packages/intelligence/src/__tests__/cross-service-linking.test.ts` — a path no commit on any ref has ever
added — while the exclusion gate passed, because the config and the register agreed.
`v8IgnoreDirectives` is a ratchet on source annotations. It is currently 0 — the several `v8 ignore`
occurrences in the tree are prose describing earlier removals, not directives. A new directive fails the
gate until this number is deliberately raised, which forces the reason into the same review.

configEntries.packages/web/**: The web dashboard has its own vitest configuration and its own coverage run; including it here would measure it against a test selection that never executes it.
configEntries.packages/vscode/**: The VS Code extension runs with its own config because the extension host is not available under the root pool. Its suite is executed separately in CI (780 tests).
configEntries.**/benchmarks/ca-bench/suites/**: Benchmark suites, not tests. They are executed by the benchmark workflow, and measuring them as unit tests would report assertions that were never meant to exist.
configEntries.**/benchmarks/ca-bench/fixtures/**: Fixture material for the benchmark suites — data, not code under test.
configEntries.**/benchmarks/search-benchmark.test.ts: A search-relevance benchmark whose timings are the result; the assertions are sanity checks around a measurement, not a unit test.
configEntries.tests/benchmarks/real-world/__tests__/sc: Scale stress: ~9.3K synthetic files across four tiers to probe O(n^2) cliffs. Under the default unit-test pool it OOMs a single worker, and its heap-delta assertions are GC-timing sensitive. Run with `pnpm test:stress` (vitest.stress.config.ts), not by passing the path to the unit run.
